chooseResponse.q: What did you think of the lecture?

conversation.transcript:
Student: Hey, did you go to the art exhibit last night?
Advisor: Yes, I did! It was amazing. What did you think?
Student: I loved the interactive installations. They were so engaging.
Advisor: Absolutely! I spent a lot of time at the virtual reality section.

talk.transcript: Today, we will explore the concept of renewable energy. Renewable energy comes from sources that are naturally replenished, such as solar, wind, and hydropower. Unlike fossil fuels, which can take millions of years to form, renewable energy can be generated continuously. For instance, solar panels convert sunlight into electricity, while wind turbines harness wind power. The shift to renewable energy is essential for reducing greenhouse gas emissions and combating climate change. By investing in these technologies, we can create a sustainable energy future for generations to come.

questions.explain: 可再生能源來自自然來源，能不斷補充。

questions.q: Why is the shift to renewable energy important?
questions.explain: 轉向可再生能源有助於減少溫室氣體排放，對抗氣候變化。
太陽能電池板將陽光轉換為電力。

questions.q: What is one benefit of renewable energy mentioned?
questions.explain: 可再生能源的好處之一是可以持續生成，這使其成為可持續的選擇。
